description: Edits an assignment's content (title/description/priority/due_at/attachment) — only the assigner may call this, and only before the job reaches a terminal state. assigned_to cannot move here even though it is a writable column: reassigning is a separate transition that also opens a 30-second undo window. NEXT: team_assignment_reassign to hand the job to someone else.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at from a prior read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT — another writer changed this assignment first.
